title: The Quiet Postcard
author: K. M. Halloran
blurb: Kestrel Almeida, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
